Every year, an unnatural number of students go missing at this school.
Sure, all kinds of weird things happen here.
You already know that from the six people I gathered today, right?
Maybe that's exactly why nobody finds it strange...
But even with all the evil spirits and monsters around here, there are way too many victims.
So here's what I think.
Maybe someone's using this school's rumors as cover to snatch students... is what I think.
...Maybe I'm overthinking it.
But unless I think of it that way, it just doesn't add up.
So... you've figured it out by now, haven't you?
Who it is I suspect.
Today, I'm going to drag everything out into the open.{p}

These guys...
You mean these little creatures{f:?|?}
"That's right. I'm going to breed lots and lots of them."
Hino nodded.

Something was wrong{f:.|.}
{f:I|I} had only thought it in my head{f:.|.}

So how did Hino......?{p}

...................................................When I came to, {f:I|I} was lying on a hard bed.
Right beside me lay the six others, Iwashita, Shindo and the rest, asleep.
...Where {f:was I|was I}?
{f:I|I} looked around the room.
It was dim{f:.|.}

{f:I|I} went closer.

"I'LL LET YOU ALL LIVE.
